item.title: Kim Yong-beom: “Delisting Samsung Electronics-SK Hynix Leverage ETFs Is Difficult... Considering Various Options” (김용범 “삼전닉스 레버리지, 상장폐지는 어려워... 다양한 방법 고민”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom: “Delisting Samsung Electronics-SK Hynix Leverage ETFs Is Difficult... Considering Various Options” (김용범 “삼전닉스 레버리지, 상장폐지는 어려워... 다양한 방법 고민”)

Kim Yong-beom, head of the policy office at the presidential office, stated on the 19th regarding the controversy over single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix: “Delisting is realistically difficult to consider,” adding, “We need to further explore various ways to minimize market impact.” <<> Appearing on KBS’s “Sunday Diagnosis” that day, Director Kim said, “If we delist a product that investors are already invested in, with a scale exceeding 10 trillion won, it would itself cause a massive shock to the market.” <<> He highlighted the issue of the premium/discount rate—the gap between the market price and the net asset value of ETF products—noting, “There is an aspect where market impact occurs as buying and selling are concentrated in the last 30 minutes before market close to adjust the premium/discount rate.” He added, “It seems the authorities and securities firms need to engage in further dialogue, including whether the premium/discount rate management period must strictly be within 30 minutes, whether the time frame can be expanded, or whether it can be managed through methods other than spot trading.” <<> Regarding recent remarks by Financial Supervisory Service Governor Lee Chan-jin, who said about single-stock leveraged ETFs, “I personally reflect on whether I should have blocked it by lying down,” Director Kim commented, “I later heard him say his intent was that reviews or similar processes should have been stricter,” and added, “It was a decision made through mutual consultation.” <<> On the real estate market, Director Kim said, “I am truly sorry to the people,” and assessed, “Both supply and demand sides are in a very challenging situation.” He stated, “We are trying to secure short-term effective supply volumes by mobilizing them comprehensively, including non-apartment housing, purchase-lease properties, officetel supply, and conversion of commercial land to residential use.” Regarding the plan to use semi-industrial zones in Seoul for housing supply, he said, “It’s not just a Seoul city issue; collaboration with the central government could yield much greater results, so I’ve made an appointment to meet separately with Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon.” <<> On tax reform directions, he said, “At the discussion forum, many opinions were raised that even for single-home owner-occupied properties, very high-priced homes should be viewed differently from mid-priced homes, considering factors like affordability and impact on the housing market, and there is some judgment on that direction.” He added, “The appropriate price level and criteria will be determined after hearing more public opinions and discussions, and will be included in the tax reform proposal to be announced at the end of this month.” Regarding the relationship between property-holding taxes and capital gains taxes, he said, “We are taking it fully into account,” but added, “It’s difficult to uniformly say that raising property-holding taxes must necessarily lower capital gains taxes.” <<> Meanwhile, regarding the criticism that Korea’s promised investment projects in the U.S. as a quid pro quo for tariff reductions are being delayed, Director Kim responded, “That’s not the case. It’s progressing on a proper schedule,” and said, “We are preparing to realize the first U.S. investment project.” When asked about the timing of making the U.S. investments visible, he replied, “It should happen by August or September, shouldn’t it?” <<>> (김용범 청와대 정책실장이 19일 삼성전자·SK하이닉스 단일종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF) 논란에 대해 “상장 폐지는 사실 생각하기 어렵다”며 “시장 충격을 최소화할 수 있는 다양한 방법을 더 고민해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Spouse of the Late Lee Hae-chan Becomes Chairman of Chung Cheong-rae’s Support Committee… “I Will Carry on the Legacy of the Former Party Leader” (정청래 후원회장에 故 이해찬 배우자… “선배 당대표 뜻 잇겠다”)
item.description:
Spouse of the Late Lee Hae-chan Becomes Chairman of Chung Cheong-rae’s Support Committee… “I Will Carry on the Legacy of the Former Party Leader” (정청래 후원회장에 故 이해찬 배우자… “선배 당대표 뜻 잇겠다”)

Chung Cheong-rae, a former lawmaker running in the Democratic Party of Korea’s August 17 party convention leadership election, announced on the 19th that Kim Jeong-ok, the spouse of the late former Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan, has agreed to serve as the chair of his support committee. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에 출마한 정청래 전 대표는 19일 고(故) 이해찬 전 국무총리의 배우자인 김정옥 여사가 후원회장을 맡기로 했다고 밝혔다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Chung revealed his recent meeting with Madam Kim, stating, “The moment I heard that Madam Kim was willing to serve as the chair of my support committee, I felt a heavy sense of responsibility weighing on my shoulders.” (정 전 대표는 이날 페이스북에서 최근 김 여사와 만났다는 사실을 알리며 “김 여사께서 제 후원회장을 기꺼이 맡아주시겠다는 말씀을 듣는 순간 정말 무거운 책임감에 어깨가 무거웠다”고 했다.)

Chung said, “I was struck by the weight of it, as if another living Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan were speaking, and the responsibility to not tarnish the honor of Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan swept over me.” He added, “I told Madam, ‘Making the Democratic Party truly democratic! A strong reformist party leader’ is my slogan, and I pledged to become exactly that kind of party leader.” (정 전 대표는 “살아있는 또 한 분의 이해찬 총리님께서 말씀하시는 듯한 무게감, 이해찬 총리님의 명예에 누가 되지 않아야 한다는 책임감이 엄습했다”며 “사모님께 ‘민주당을 민주당답게! 강력한 개혁당대표’가 제 슬로건이고 또 꼭 그런 당대표가 되겠다고 말씀드렸다”고 전했다.)

He continued, “I told her that internally, I aim for ‘four-way integration,’ externally for unity and solidarity, and that the Democratic Party’s identity lies in reform upon reform, and I vowed to see prosecutorial reform through to the end.” He added, “Madam emphasized the Democratic Party’s identity and legitimacy over and over, saying, ‘Please make sure to do that.’” (그는 “당 안으로 ‘4통 통합’, 당 밖으로 통합과 연대, 그리고 민주당의 정체성은 개혁하고 또 개혁이고, 검찰개혁을 꼭 완수하겠다고 말씀드렸다”며 “사모님께서는 ‘꼭 그렇게 해달라’며 민주당 정체성과 정통성을 내내 강조하셨다”고 했다.)

Chung then stated, “With the spirit of Lee Hae-chan, I will complete prosecutorial reform and make the Democratic Party a more reform-oriented party. As a junior party leader, I will carry on the path of my senior party leader, upholding his will, and with the spirit of Lee Hae-chan, I will transform the Democratic Party into a democratic, people’s party that wins through reform.” (정 전 대표는 그러면서 “이해찬 정신으로 검찰 개혁을 완수하고 민주당을 더 개혁적인 정당으로 만들겠다”며 “선배 당대표의 길을 후배 당대표로서 그 뜻을 이어가면서 이해찬 정신으로 민주당을 민주적 국민 정당, 개혁해서 승리하는 정당으로 만들겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "On raising the party convention deposit, young candidates are struggling; it should be reversed... This is not interference in party affairs" (李대통령, 與 전대 기탁금 인상에 “청년 후보들 힘들어해, 되돌려야...당무개입 아니다”)
item.description:
President Lee: "On raising the party convention deposit, young candidates are struggling; it should be reversed... This is not interference in party affairs" (李대통령, 與 전대 기탁금 인상에 “청년 후보들 힘들어해, 되돌려야...당무개입 아니다”)

President Lee Jae-myung said on the 19th regarding the election deposits that candidates running in the Democratic Party of Korea's national convention must pay: "In this party leadership election, the deposit has been significantly raised, and especially for young candidates, it has increased several times, causing them hardship—I find this regrettable." He added, "The party's finances are not in difficulty, and considering the struggles of young people and the need for policy consideration, if possible, I suggest considering restoring the deposit to its previous level." <<> In a post on X (formerly Twitter) that day, President Lee stated: "Sitting lawmakers may have less burden due to their salaries and political funds, but for those outside the National Assembly, especially young people, the burden will be heavy." He further said, "Some might point out this as interference in party affairs, but under current laws and party regulations, the president, as a party member, is allowed to express opinions on the affairs of his affiliated party, so I hope there is no misunderstanding." <<> Earlier, on the 14th, the Democratic Party announced through candidate registration notices that the preliminary election deposit for party leader and supreme council member candidates would be 20 million won. In last year's national convention, the deposit was 15 million won for party leader candidates and 5 million won for supreme council member candidates. <<> In his post that day, President Lee said: "It is sad that people cannot run for office because of money, but it also increases the temptation for corruption. As a senior who overcame the pain of being penniless in youth and broke through barriers of privilege through countless challenges, I want to at least promote the donation accounts for young candidates." <<> President Lee's post that day sparked interpretations within the ruling party that it was a show of support for Jeong Min-cheol, the deputy policy committee chair who registered as a supreme council member candidate. Deputy Jeong had disclosed his personal account to raise funds for the 20 million won deposit and collected donations, but when it was pointed out that this might violate the Political Funds Act, he stated that he had not properly reviewed the legal aspects and would return the funds. Deputy Jeong also expressed on YouTube that for non-incumbent politicians, especially young ones, raising the deposit is not easy. Recently, Deputy Jeong has shown support for President Lee by criticizing figures like Yoo Si-min, who have taken a critical stance toward President Lee. <<> On online bulletin boards mainly used by Democratic Party supporters, responses such as "The president has openly sent a message to rescue the pro-Lee candidate Jeong Min-cheol" have appeared. This comes amid competition between pro-Lee Jae-myung and pro-Jung Chung-rae candidates in the upcoming party leadership and supreme council member elections, with President Lee reportedly issuing a message to aid the pro-Lee Jae-myung candidate. (이재명 대통령은 19일 더불어민주당 전당대회에 출마하는 후보들이 내야 하는 선거 기탁금에 대해 “이번 당 지도부 선거에서 기탁금이 대폭 상향되고 특히 청년 후보의 기탁금은 몇 배로 늘어나 청년 후보들이 힘들어한다니 아쉽다”며 “당의 재정이 어려운 것도 아니고 청년들의 어려움과 정책적 배려의 필요성도 있으니 가능하다면 기탁금을 종전 수준으로 되돌리는 걸 고려해 보시면 어떨까 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Yoo Si-min’s ‘Lee Will Definitely Lose’ Controversy… Pro-Moon Yoon Geon-young: “Should Be Seen as a Preventive Shot” (유시민 ‘李 필패론’ 논란에… 친문 윤건영 “예방주사로 봐야”)
item.description:
Yoo Si-min’s ‘Lee Will Definitely Lose’ Controversy… Pro-Moon Yoon Geon-young: “Should Be Seen as a Preventive Shot” (유시민 ‘李 필패론’ 논란에… 친문 윤건영 “예방주사로 봐야”)

Yoon Geon-young, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea known as a close aide to former President Moon Jae-in, commented on author Yoo Si-min’s claim that President Lee Jae-myung might interfere in the party leadership primary, saying, “I wonder if it really goes that far,” but added, “Those close to the President consistently talk about former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok.” <<> Lawmaker Yoon stated, “I’ve even heard they emotionally dislike lawmaker Jeong Cheong-rae,” and added, “This inevitably raises suspicion among many party members.” While he finds it hard to believe Yoo’s claim that President Lee is pushing former Prime Minister Kim as the next party leader, his remarks suggest that the behavior of pro-Lee figures could still warrant such doubts. <<> On the 19th, Lawmaker Yoon posted an article titled “Looking at Yoo Si-min Correctly” on Facebook, expressing his stance on the controversy surrounding Yoo’s recent comments. <<> First, he noted, “The whole town is buzzing about author Yoo Si-min’s story,” adding, “Reactions range from very critical to those who understand his earnestness.” <<> He then said, “I found it a bit uncomfortable to listen to,” and “Regardless of whether the content is right or wrong, I wondered if it had to be said this way,” expressing regret over Yoo’s method of raising the issue and the level of his expressions. <<> Lawmaker Yoon remarked, “The point made by Maebul Show host Choi Wook resonated with me,” and “I felt it was regrettable that there wasn’t a softer approach, or a way to discuss it while uniting the faction.” <<> At the same time, he said, “It was like the Yoo Si-min I know,” adding, “When he’s on our side, it’s exhilarating, but when he’s the opponent, it’s painfully piercing to the core. So it might be uncomfortable.” <<> Lawmaker Yoon emphasized that the focus should be on the content of Yoo’s criticism rather than his delivery style. <<> He said, “Some people get angry, claiming author Yoo pointed at the moon and criticized the finger, or that he clenched his fist,” and added, “It would be better to look at the moon he’s pointing at, not his finger.” <<> However, he stated that he finds it difficult to agree with Yoo’s claim about the possible failure of a “structural majority.” <<> Lawmaker Yoon said, “There are logical contradictions in his argument that I can’t easily accept,” and noted, “Especially his diagnosis of the structural majority.” <<> He continued, “In my view, what President Lee referred to as a structural majority is probably about correcting a tilted playing field,” adding, “It seems like a will to flatten the playing field of our society, which has been dominated by conservatives since liberation.” <<> He assessed, “An artificial reorganization of the political landscape is neither possible nor has the momentum right now,” and “Yet author Yoo concluded by presenting the possibility of failure for a structural majority. It feels somewhat logically stretched, unlike him.” <<> He drew a line regarding criticism of Yoo’s attitude and metaphors. Lawmaker Yoon argued, “Author Yoo is a commentator, not a player on the field,” and “I don’t think we should demand the same strict attitude and metaphors required of a player.” <<> Lawmaker Yoon then mentioned specific issues Yoo raised, such as prosecutorial reform and the party leadership primary. <<> Regarding prosecutorial reform, he said, “Author Yoo said the priority is for the President to provide a frank explanation and seek public understanding,” and “I don’t doubt the President’s will to separate investigation and prosecution.” <<> He added, “After all, President Lee is someone who has suffered damage from political prosecutors more than anyone.” <<> Nevertheless, he expressed doubts about the remarks of some who claim to be close to the President. Lawmaker Yoon stated, “Lately, seeing the words and actions of some so-called self-proclaimed presidential aides raises suspicion,” and “Even now, they are demanding supplementary investigative powers,” adding, “That’s how Machiavelli’s The Prince comes into play.” <<> Regarding the party leadership primary, he interpreted that Yoo was arguing that President Lee is effectively supporting former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok. <<> Lawmaker Yoon said, “Author Yoo seems to think the President is unnecessarily interfering in the party,” and “The prime example he gave is supporting former Prime Minister Kim in the party leadership primary.” <<> He then added, “I wonder if it really goes that far,” but noted, “Those close to the President consistently talk about former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok.” <<> He further stated, “I’ve even heard they emotionally dislike lawmaker Jeong Cheong-rae,” and “This inevitably raises suspicion among many party members.” <<> Lawmaker Yoon added that he does not support either former Prime Minister Kim or lawmaker Jeong. <<> He also mentioned that author Yoo had cited the so-called “Myung-pick” controversy as an example, saying, “This is why author Yoo Si-min’s claims are concerning.” <<> He expressed worry, “If what he claims is true or close to the truth, it’s a really serious problem,” adding, “Before even talking about a structural majority, our internal cohesion could crack and collapse.” <<> Lawmaker Yoon argued that Yoo’s claims should be seen as a kind of well-intentioned warning to the party and government. He said, “I wonder if we could see author Yoo Si-min’s statements as a preventive shot for everyone,” adding, “It may not be the time for vaccination, but getting it in advance probably won’t hurt.” <<> He continued, “I hope we can listen and communicate over a glass of makgeolli,” and “I’ve seen many cases where such issues pile up, leading to relationships where people can’t even share a meal. I hope from now on, we can openly share each other’s concerns.” <<> Lawmaker Yoon concluded his post by expressing hope that Yoo’s concerns would not come true. He said, “Author Yoo said he hopes to fail. I feel the same,” and “I sincerely hope his prediction turns out to be completely wrong.” <<> He added, “The Lee Jae-myung administration must succeed,” and “The Moon Jae-in administration came from Park Geun-hye’s impeachment, and the Lee Jae-myung administration from Yoon Seok-yeol’s impeachment. If the Lee Jae-myung administration fails, we won’t even be able to look the people in the eye.” <<> Lawmaker Yoon’s latest stance comes amid growing controversy within the ruling party over Yoo’s so-called “Lee Jae-myung will definitely lose” theory. In political circles, there have been interpretations that Yoo’s comments effectively signal his entry into the Democratic Party’s convention, rallying pro-Roh and pro-Moon factions, and siding with former lawmaker Jeong Cheong-rae against the pro-Lee camp. In this context, with Yoon, a close confidant of former President Moon, distancing himself from Yoo’s expression but insisting that much of his criticism should be heeded, there is a view that he has partially aligned with Yoo’s assessment of the ruling bloc. <<> (문재인 전 대통령의 최측근으로 알려진 윤건영 더불어민주당 의원이 이재명 대통령의 당대표 경선 개입 가능성을 거론한 유시민 작가의 주장에 대해 “설마 그렇게까지일까 싶다”면서도 “대통령과 가까운 이들이 한결같이 김민석 전 총리 이야기를 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Clash over the Ruling Party Convention Deposits: Lee Says, "Interference in Party Affairs? Even the President is a Party Member." (‘與 전대 기탁금’ 놓고 설전… 李 “당무개입? 대통령도 당원”)
item.description:
Clash over the Ruling Party Convention Deposits: Lee Says, "Interference in Party Affairs? Even the President is a Party Member." (‘與 전대 기탁금’ 놓고 설전… 李 “당무개입? 대통령도 당원”)

On the 19th, President Lee Jae-myung posted on X (formerly Twitter) criticizing the excessively high convention deposits for the Democratic Party of Korea's leadership race. When a netizen pointed out that it might constitute "interference in party affairs," which is illegal, Lee countered that it was not. This sparked a debate on X between the President and the netizen, believed to be a Democratic Party member. (이재명 대통령은 19일 X(옛 트위터)에 더불어민주당의 전당대회 기탁금이 너무 높다는 내용의 글을 올렸다가, 한 네티즌으로부터 ‘당무 개입은 위법’이라는 지적이 나오자, 이에 ‘당무 개입이 아니다’라고 다시 반박했다. 이 대통령이 민주당 당원으로 추정되는 네티즌과 X로 논쟁을 주고받은 것이다.)

Earlier that day, at 12:28 PM, President Lee posted on X about the excessive deposits required for candidates running for party leader and Supreme Council members in the Democratic Party convention. The Democratic Party had raised the preliminary election deposit to 20 million won ahead of this convention. During last year's convention, deposits were 15 million won for party leader candidates and 5 million won for Supreme Council candidates. (앞서 이 대통령은 이날 오후 12시 28분 X에 민주당 전당대회에 출마하는 당대표와 최고위원 후보들이 내야 하는 기탁금이 너무 높다는 글을 올렸다. 민주당은 이번 전당대회를 앞두고 예비 경선 기탁금을 2000만원으로 올렸다. 지난해 전대에선 당대표 후보는 1500만원, 최고위원 후보는 500만원이었다.)

Although President Lee's comments pertained to the party convention, he argued that "the President, as a party member, can express opinions on the affairs of the party they belong to," stating that this does not amount to interference in party affairs. (이 대통령은 당 전당대회에 관한 언급이지만 “대통령도 당원으로서 소속 정당 당무에 대해 의견을 낼 수 있다”며 당무 개입은 아니라고 했다.)

In response to President Lee's post, a netizen presumed to be a Democratic Party member commented, "It seems you are confusing whether you are the President or the Democratic Party leader right now. This is interference in party affairs—Park Geun-hye got two years in prison, and former President Roh Moo-hyun was nearly impeached just for saying 'Please look favorably on the Uri Party,' which wasn't even interference. Please keep that in mind." (이 대통령이 올린 글에, 민주당 당원으로 추정되는 한 네티즌은 “지금 당신이 대통령인지 민주당 당대표인지 착각하는 것 같다”며 “당무 개입으로 박근혜 2년 감방, 노무현 전 대통령님은 당무 개입도 아닌데 ‘열린우리당 잘 봐달라’는 말 한마디에 탄핵까지 당하실 뻔했다. 명심하시길”이라는 댓글을 달았다.)

In response, President Lee posted a rebuttal at 2:45 PM the same day. He stated, "The case of President Park Geun-hye was problematic because she intervened in nominations or primaries for public office elections, not because she expressed opinions on routine party affairs." He added, "The President is also recognized under the law and the Democratic Party's constitution and rules to have the right to participate as a party member. Therefore, offering opinions on the sudden excessive increase in youth deposits cannot be considered interference in party affairs." (이에 이 대통령은 오후 2시 45분 이 네티즌의 글에 다시 반박 글을 올렸다. 이 대통령은 “박근혜 대통령 사례는 공직선거 후보 공천이나 경선에 개입했기 때문에 문제된 것이지 일상적 당무에 의견을 낸 것이 된 것이 아니다”라고 했다. 그러면서 “대통령도 법률과 민주당 당헌당규에 의하여 당원으로서 참여할 권리가 인정되고 있으니, 급작스러운 청년기탁금의 과도한 인상에 대해 의견을 내는 것이 당무 개입일 수는 없답니다”라고 했다.)

President Lee continued, "My comments on the deposits, especially youth deposits, are not meant to favor any specific candidate but because youth issues are the greatest social challenge in our society. The youth deposit problem could serve as a trigger for young people to fundamentally question the ruling power's—including the Democratic Party and the government—perception of youth. As a Democratic Party member, I hope the party, as a partner in governance, respects the will of its members and the people and faithfully fulfills it, becoming a capable and strong democratic party. Please understand that." (이 대통령은 “제가 기탁금, 특히 청년 기탁금에 대해 의견을 내는 것은 특정 후보를 편들자고 하는 것이 아니라, 청년 문제는 우리 사회 최대의 사회 문제이고 이 청년 기탁금 문제는 청년들이 민주당 그리고 정부를 포함한 집권세력의 청년인식에 대해 근본적 의문을 가지게 하는 단초가 될 수 있기 때문”이라며 “대통령도 민주당 당원으로서 국정의 동반자인 민주당이 당원과 국민의 뜻을 존중하고 제대로 실천하는, 유능하고 강한 민주적 정당이 되기를 염원하고 있음을 헤아려 주시기 바란다”고 했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon: "Ruling Party's Bill Allows Police 'Arrest Without Warrant'" (한동훈 “與 법안, 경찰의 ‘영장 없는 긴급체포’ 허용”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon: "Ruling Party's Bill Allows Police 'Arrest Without Warrant'" (한동훈 “與 법안, 경찰의 ‘영장 없는 긴급체포’ 허용”)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon stated on the 19th regarding the Democratic Party of Korea’s push to abolish supplementary investigation powers, "The Democratic Party has hidden a 'bomb' that allows police 'unlimited arrests without a warrant.'" (무소속 한동훈 의원은 19일 더불어민주당이 추진하는 보완수사권 폐지 법안과 관련해 “민주당이 ‘경찰의 영장 없는 긴급체포 무제한 허용’이라는 ‘폭탄’을 숨겨놓았다”고 했다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Han said, "While pushing for the ban on supplementary investigations this time, the Democratic Party has quietly made it so that police no longer need to receive approval from a prosecutor after an emergency arrest (they silently changed 'approval' to a simple 'post-hoc notification')." (한 의원은 이날 페이스북 글에서 “민주당은 이번에 보완수사 금지를 추진하면서 슬그머니 경찰이 긴급 체포 후 검사의 승인(‘승인’을 ‘단순 사후통보’로 슬그머니 바꿨습니다)을 받을 필요조차 없도록 했다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Han noted, "Currently, if police arrest a citizen without a warrant, they must immediately (within 12 hours) obtain approval from a prosecutor, and if not approved, the person must be released. This is a minimal safety belt to prevent abuse of emergency arrests and protect citizens' human rights." He added, "In the world created by the Democratic Party, police can arrest citizens 'without a warrant' unlimitedly, without anyone's oversight or checks. Emergency arrests without a warrant by police will inevitably be abused, and the citizens will bear the harm." <<> Meanwhile, Han had planned to engage in a face-to-face debate with Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Geon-tae over the abolition of supplementary investigation powers, but the debate fell through after Lee declared his non-participation. Regarding this, Han said, "The Democratic Party regime, are you going to run away from the 'debate on the unlimited emergency arrest without a warrant by police' as well?" (한 의원은 “지금은 경찰이 시민을 영장없이 체포하면 즉시(12시간 내) 검사의 승인을 받아야 하고, 승인을 받지 못하면 석방해야 한다”며 “긴급체포 남용을 방지하고 시민의 인권을 지키기 위한 최소한의 안전벨트”라고 했다. 이어 “민주당이 만든 세상에서는 경찰이 누구의 눈치도 견제도 없이 시민을 ‘영장 없이’ 무제한으로 체포하게 된다”며 “경찰의 영장 없는 긴급 체포는 필연적으로 남용되고, 피해는 시민에게 돌아간다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "The Essence of the Party Convention is a 'Disguised Anti-Myung Divisionism' and a War Against the 'Shincheonji'" (김민석 “전당대회 본질은 ‘위장한 반명 분열주의’ ‘신천지’와의 대전”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: "The Essence of the Party Convention is a 'Disguised Anti-Myung Divisionism' and a War Against the 'Shincheonji'" (김민석 “전당대회 본질은 ‘위장한 반명 분열주의’ ‘신천지’와의 대전”)

Kim Min-seok, a former Prime Minister who is running in the Democratic Party of Korea's party leadership election, has defined the upcoming August 17th party convention as an election against 'anti-Myung (anti-Lee Jae-myung) divisionism' and the potential interference of Shincheonji, urging party members to participate in voting. (더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 전 국무총리가 이번 8·17 전당대회를 ‘반명(反明·반이재명) 분열주의’와 신천지의 개입 가능성에 맞서는 선거로 규정하며 당원들의 투표 참여를 촉구했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 19th, former Prime Minister Kim stated, "I warned about martial law and struck down the 'Lee Nak-yon style sakura,'" adding, "The essence of this convention is ultimately a war against disguised anti-Myung divisionism and Shincheonji." (김 전 총리는 19일 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “(저는) 계엄을 경고했고, ‘이낙연식 사쿠라’를 쳤다”며 “이번 전대의 본질은 결국 위장한 반명 분열주의 및 신천지와의 대회 전(戰)”이라고 밝혔다.)

Kim further said, "Is it about the success of the Lee Jae-myung government and victory in the general election, or shaking the Lee Jae-myung government and splitting the Democratic Party?" He framed the party leadership election as a choice between establishing a leadership that supports the stable administration of the Lee Jae-myung government or one that leads to internal division. (김 전 총리는 이어 “이재명 정부의 성공과 총선 승리냐, 이재명 정부 흔들기와 민주당 쪼개기냐”라고 했다. 이번 당대표 선거를 이재명 정부의 안정적 국정 운영을 뒷받침할 지도부를 세울 것인지, 당내 분열로 이어질 것인지를 결정하는 선택으로 제시한 것이다.)

Kim emphasized, "The only solution is 100% participation and voting by all party members," stressing, "The fate of the Democratic Party, the Lee Jae-myung government, and the Republic of Korea depends on the voting of all party members and genuine party member sovereignty." He added, "Please protect the Lee Jae-myung government and the Democratic Party through full participation in voting." (김 전 총리는 “유일한 해법은 전 당원의 100% 참여와 투표”라며 “모든 당원의 투표와 진짜 당원 주권에 민주당과 이재명 정부, 대한민국의 운명이 달려 있다”고 강조했다. 그러면서 “빠짐없는 투표로 이재명 정부와 민주당을 지켜 달라”고 했다.)

The phrase 'Lee Nak-yon style sakura' is interpreted as targeting the situation when former Prime Minister Lee Nak-yon left the party and formed a new party, causing party fragmentation, during President Lee Jae-myung's tenure as party leader. Analysts see this as former Prime Minister Kim raising caution and a sense of crisis that anti-Myung forces, or those disguised as anti-Myung, could use this convention as an opportunity to shake party unity again. 'Sakura' is the Japanese word for cherry blossoms and has been used in Yeouido to mean 'collaborator' or 'turncoat.' (‘이낙연식 사쿠라’라는 표현은 이재명 대통령이 민주당 대표를 맡았던 시기 이낙연 전 국무총리의 탈당과 신당 창당 등으로 당이 분화했던 상황을 겨냥한 것으로 풀이된다. 김 전 총리가 당내 비명계 또는 비명계로 위장한 세력이 이번 전당대회를 계기로 다시 당의 결속을 흔들 수 있다는 경계심과 위기감을 제기한 것이라는 해석이다. 사쿠라는 벚꽃의 일본어로, 여의도에선 과거부터 ‘야합자’ ‘변절자’의 의미로 쓰여왔다.)

Kim's reference to having publicly raised and warned about the possibility of the Yoon Seok-yul government preparing for martial law in 2024 also appears to be an effort to re-emphasize his role and achievements as a Supreme Council member under then-leader Lee Jae-myung. (김 전 총리가 2024년 윤석열 정부의 계엄 준비 가능성을 공개적으로 제기하고 경고했던 일을 소환한 것도 이재명 당 대표 당시 최고위원이었던 자신의 역할과 성과 등을 재차 강조한 것으로 보인다.)

Kim repeatedly raised the possibility of Shincheonji's interference in the party convention. After finishing a meeting with party members in Busan on the same day, he told reporters, "This party convention is one to firmly establish the leadership of the Lee Jae-myung government and the ruling party that supports it," adding, "Disguised anti-Myung divisionism and Shincheonji-like clandestine activities are the biggest obstacles." (김 전 총리는 신천지의 전당대회 개입 가능성도 거듭 제기했다. 그는 이날 부산에서 당원 간담회를 마친 뒤 기자들과 만나 “이번 전당대회는 이재명 정부와 이를 뒷받침하는 집권 여당의 리더십을 확고히 세우는 전당대회”라며 “위장된 반명 분열주의와 신천지적 암약은 최대의 걸림돌”이라고 말했다.)

However, in his public remarks that day, Kim did not present specific circumstances or evidence that Shincheonji is systematically interfering in the Democratic Party's convention. (다만 김 전 총리는 이날 공개 발언에서 신천지가 민주당 전당대회에 조직적으로 개입하고 있다는 구체적인 정황이나 근거를 제시하지는 않았다.)

Aides to former Prime Minister Kim explained that he preemptively raised concerns, considering existing controversies over Shincheonji's interference in politics. A source close to Kim said, "The concerns were raised as an extension of Shincheonji's past behavior," adding, "Since it's difficult to eliminate this with only voting by a portion of eligible party members, the intent is to urge all party members to vote." (김 전 총리 측은 신천지를 둘러싼 기존의 정치권 개입 논란을 고려해 선제적으로 우려를 제기한 것이라고 설명했다. 김 전 총리 측 관계자는 “신천지가 보여 온 기존 행태의 연장선에서 관련 우려를 제기한 것”이라며 “일부 권리당원만 투표해서는 이를 일소하기 어려운 만큼 모든 당원이 투표에 참여해 달라는 취지”라고 말했다.)

Kim's remarks are interpreted as a message aiming to frame the party convention not as a competition among individual candidates but as a confrontation between forces supporting the Lee Jae-myung government and those trying to shake the party. At the same time, it seems to contain a strategy to boost overall voter turnout among party members and consolidate support by highlighting the potential involvement of a religious group. (김 전 총리의 발언은 전당대회 구도를 후보 개인 간 경쟁이 아니라 이재명 정부를 지지하는 세력과 당을 흔드는 세력의 대결로 설정하려는 메시지로 해석된다. 동시에 종교단체의 개입 가능성을 전면에 내세우면서 전당원 투표율을 끌어올리고 지지층의 결집을 유도하려는 전략도 담긴 것으로 보인다.)

Before visiting Busan, former Prime Minister Kim visited Andong in North Gyeongsang Province, the hometown of President Lee Jae-myung. When Andong City Council Speaker Lee Jae-gap said, "Citizens have high hopes for the Democratic Party," Kim responded, "Hope has already been planted by the President, and I intend to add water to it." (김 전 총리는 부산 방문에 앞서 이재명 대통령의 고향인 경북 안동을 찾았다. 안동시의회에서 이재갑 의장이 “시민들이 민주당에 많은 희망을 걸고 있다”고 말하자 김 전 총리는 “희망은 이미 대통령님이 심으셨고, 저는 물을 보태려고 한다”고 답했다.)

Amidst this, the Democratic Party is scheduled to begin its preliminary primary voting on the 21st. Three out of five party leadership candidates and eight out of fourteen Supreme Council candidates will advance to the main primary. After voting by eligible party members, central committee members, and the general public, the finalists for the main primary will be announced on the 23rd. <<>> (이런 가운데 민주당은 21일부터 예비경선 투표에 들어갈 예정이다. 당대표 후보 5명 가운데 3명, 최고위원 후보 14명 가운데 8명이 본경선에 진출한다. 권리당원과 중앙위원, 일반 국민 투표를 거쳐 23일 본경선 진출자가 발표된다.)

item.title: President Lee: "World Heritage, a Symbol Uniting Humanity... Culture Is the Most Powerful Force" (李대통령 “세계유산, 인류 하나로 묶는 상징...문화는 가장 강력한 힘”)
item.description:
President Lee: "World Heritage, a Symbol Uniting Humanity... Culture Is the Most Powerful Force" (李대통령 “세계유산, 인류 하나로 묶는 상징...문화는 가장 강력한 힘”)

President Lee Jae-myung attended the opening ceremony of the 48th session of the UNESCO World Heritage Committee held in Busan on the 19th and stated, "World heritage is a symbol that transcends borders and generations, uniting humanity together, and a solid foundation that enables peace and cooperation between nations." He added, "We will work with UNESCO to create a more peaceful and prosperous future for humanity in solidarity with the entire world." (이재명 대통령은 19일 부산에서 열린 제48차 유네스코 세계유산위원회 개회식에 참석해 “세계 유산은 국경과 세대를 초월해 인류를 하나로 묶어주는 상징이자 국가 간 평화와 협력을 실천하게 하는 단단한 기반”이라며 “전 세계와 연대하며 더 평화롭고 더 풍요로운 인류의 미래를 유네스코와 함께 만들어 가겠다”고 했다.)

In his congratulatory speech at the event, President Lee said, "In an era groaning under conflict and division, the value of dialogue mediated through culture becomes even more precious." He continued, "Culture is a soft but most powerful force that transcends any language or border, enabling mutual understanding and empathy," adding, "In the process of remembering and preserving world heritage together, the entire world will be able to respect each other's history, and further solidify mutual trust and the solidarity of the human community." (이 대통령은 이날 행사 축사에서 “갈등과 분열로 신음하는 시대일수록 문화를 매개로 한 대화의 가치는 더욱 소중하다”며 이같이 말했다. 이 대통령은 “문화는 어떠한 언어도, 어떠한 국경도 뛰어넘어 서로를 이해하고 공감하게 만드는 부드럽지만 가장 강력한 힘”이라며 “세계 유산을 함께 기억하고 보존하는 과정에서 전 세계는 서로의 역사를 존중하고 상호 간 신뢰와 인류 공동체의 연대를 더욱 단단하게 다져나갈 수 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

President Lee remarked, "Decades ago, Baekbeom Kim Gu dreamed of a country that contributes to humanity through the power of a higher culture, rather than a wealthy and powerful nation." He said, "The spirit of the UNESCO Charter, which states that 'since wars begin in the minds of men, it is in the minds of men that the defenses of peace must be constructed,' points exactly to the same insight of Baekbeom Kim Gu, who sought to realize peace through culture and lead human harmony." (이 대통령은 “수십 년 전, 백범 김구 선생께서는 부강한 나라보다 높은 문화의 힘으로 인류에 공헌하는 나라를 꿈꾸셨다”며 “‘평화의 방벽을 인간의 마음속에 세워야 한다’는 유네스코 헌장의 정신은 문화로 평화를 구현하고, 인류의 화합을 이끌고자 한 백범 김구 선생의 통찰과 정확히 같은 곳을 가리키고 있다”고 했다.)

President Lee stated, "This year, which marks the 150th anniversary of Baekbeom Kim Gu's birth, it is by no means a coincidence that the UNESCO World Heritage Committee is being held in the Republic of Korea." He added, "Now, the Republic of Korea has leaped forward as a brilliant cultural powerhouse, capable of making people around the world laugh and cry with our stories." (이 대통령은 “백범 김구 선생 탄생 150주년이 되는 올해, 대한민국에서 유네스코 세계유산위원회가 열리는 것은 결코 우연이 아닐 것”이라며 “이제 대한민국은 우리의 이야기로 전 세계인을 웃기고 울리는 찬란한 문화 강국으로 도약했다”고 했다.)

President Lee expressed pride, saying, "Our Republic of Korea's journey, from a recipient nation of aid to a donor nation, and further into a country that shares the value of culture, is a shared success story of humanity created through cooperation and solidarity." He affirmed, "Based on the power of a higher culture, we will carry on Baekbeom's will as a country that jointly protects humanity's precious heritage and contributes to world peace and prosperity," and regarding cooperation with UNESCO, he stated, "As a responsible contributing nation, we will actively lend our strength to promote international cooperation and solve common challenges." (이 대통령은 “원조를 받던 나라에서 원조를 하는 나라로, 나아가 문화의 가치를 함께 나누는 나라로 성장한 우리 대한민국의 여정은 협력과 연대가 만들어 낸 인류 공동의 성공 사례라고 자부한다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “높은 문화의 힘을 바탕으로 인류의 소중한 유산을 함께 지키고 세계의 평화와 번영에 기여하는 나라로 백범 선생의 뜻을 이어가겠다”며, 유네스코와 협력에 대해 “책임 있는 기여국으로서 국제 협력을 촉진하고 공동의 도전과제 해결을 위해 적극적으로 힘을 보태겠다”고 했다.)

Prior to the opening ceremony, President Lee met with UNESCO Director-General Khalid El-Anani and discussed ways to strengthen the partnership between Korea and UNESCO. During the meeting, President Lee expressed gratitude, mentioning the establishment of a textbook printing plant with UNESCO's support during the Korean War. (이 대통령은 개회식에 앞서서는 칼레드 엘아나니 유네스코 사무총장을 접견하고 한국과 유네스코 간 파트너십 강화 방안 등에 대해 논의했다. 이 대통령은 이날 접견에서 6·25 전쟁 중 유네스코의 지원으로 교과서 인쇄공장이 설립된 사실을 언급하며 감사의 뜻을 표했다.)

item.title: President Lee Responds to PPP’s ‘Party Affairs Interference’ Criticism: “You Need Basic Common Sense... How Can You Handle State Affairs with That Capability?” (李대통령, 국힘의 ‘당무개입’ 비판에 “상식 갖춰야...그런 역량으로 국정 감당하겠나”)
item.description:
President Lee Responds to PPP’s ‘Party Affairs Interference’ Criticism: “You Need Basic Common Sense... How Can You Handle State Affairs with That Capability?” (李대통령, 국힘의 ‘당무개입’ 비판에 “상식 갖춰야...그런 역량으로 국정 감당하겠나”)

On the 19th, President Lee Jae-myung rebutted the People Power Party’s (PPP) criticism of his remarks on the Democratic Party of Korea’s convention deposit issue as “party affairs interference,” stating through a commentary, “It would be better to have at least some basic common sense when issuing critical comments.” (이재명 대통령은 19일 더불어민주당 전당대회 기탁금 문제에 대한 언급한 것을 국민의힘이 논평을 통해 “당무 개입”이라고 비판하자, “비난 논평 내실 때 최소한의 상식은 갖추시는 게 좋겠다”고 반박했다.)

President Lee wrote this on X (formerly Twitter) at 8:43 PM that day, saying, “A public party must not fail to distinguish between internal party elections and public office elections.” He added, “That is a problem as serious as being unable to differentiate between state affairs and personal business,” and “With such capability, it would be difficult to handle state affairs.” (이 대통령은 이날 오후 8시 43분 X(옛 트위터)에 “공당이 당직 선거와 공직 선거조차 구분하지 못하면 안 된다”며 이같이 썼다. 이 대통령은 “그건 국정과 개인 사업을 구별 못 하는 것만큼 심각한 문제”라며 “그런 역량으로는 국정을 감당하기 어렵다”고 했다.)

Earlier that morning, President Lee pointed out that the preliminary election deposits for candidates running in the Democratic Party convention had risen significantly compared to last year—2 million won each for both party leader and supreme council members—and suggested, “How about considering returning to the previous levels?” During last year’s convention, the preliminary election deposits were 1.5 million won for the party leader and 500,000 won for supreme council members. (앞서 이 대통령은 이날 오전 민주당 전당대회에 출마하는 후보자의 예비선거 기탁금이 당대표와 최고위원 모두 2000만원으로 작년에 비해 크게 오른 점을 지적하며 “종전 수준으로 되돌리는 걸 고려해 보면 어떨까 한다”고 했다. 작년 전당대회 때는 예비선거 기탁금이 당대표는 1500만원, 최고위원은 500만원이었다.)

The People Power Party issued a commentary on President Lee’s post, criticizing it as “a heavy-handed directive pressuring the party leadership or a clear case of party affairs interference.” In response, President Lee argued that the PPP lacked even the ‘capability’ to distinguish between party affairs interference and legitimate activities. (국민의힘은 이 대통령의 이 같은 글에 논평을 내고 “당 지도부를 압박하는 묵직한 지침이나 명백한 당무 개입”이라고 지적했다. 이에 대해 대통령은 국민의힘이 당무 개입을 구분하는 ‘역량’조차 갖추지 못했다고 반박한 것이다.)

President Lee further clarified, “A public official who is a party member’s involvement in the party’s public office elections = illegal party affairs interference and a violation of election law,” while “A party member expressing opinions on their affiliated party’s internal party elections = legitimate and lawful party activity.” (이 대통령은 “공직자인 당원의 당내 공직선거 관여 = 불법 당무 개입이자 선거법 위반”이라며 “당원의 소속 정당 당직 선거 의견 개진 = 적법하고 정당한 정당 활동”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, a netizen had questioned the party affairs interference, suggesting that the president seemed to “mistake himself for either the president or the Democratic Party leader.” In response, President Lee rebutted, “Even the president, as a party member, has the right to participate under the law and the Democratic Party’s constitution and regulations, so this cannot be considered party affairs interference.” (앞서 이 대통령은 한 네티즌이 당무 개입을 문제 삼으며 ‘대통령인지 민주당 당대표인지 착각하는 것 같다’고 지적하자, 이에 대해서도 “대통령도 법률과 민주당 당헌당규에 의하여 당원으로서 참여할 권리가 인정되고 있어 당무 개입일 수는 없다”고 반박했다.)
